description: Implementation of UDPServerSocket class methods for managing UDP socket operations, including binding, sending, receiving, and socket configuration.

classes.name: UDPServerSocket
classes.description: A class that encapsulates UDP socket operations, including binding, sending, receiving, and socket configuration options.

methods.name: Listen
methods.description: Initializes the socket, applies optional configurations like address reuse, broadcast, and multicast sharing, then binds to the specified address.

methods.name: RecvFrom
methods.description: Receives data from the socket into a buffer, capturing the sender's address.

methods.name: SendTo
methods.description: Sends data from a buffer to a specified address.

methods.name: SetReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the receive buffer.

methods.name: SetSendBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the send buffer.

methods.name: SetDoNotFragment
methods.description: Configures the socket to set the Do Not Fragment flag.

methods.name: SetMsgConfirm
methods.description: Enables or disables message confirmation.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the socket.

methods.name: GetPeerAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the address of the connected peer.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local address of the socket.

methods.name: NetLog
methods.description: Returns the NetLog associated with the socket.

methods.name: AllowAddressReuse
methods.description: Enables address reuse option.

methods.name: AllowBroadcast
methods.description: Enables broadcast option.

methods.name: AllowAddressSharingForMulticast
methods.description: Enables address sharing for multicast.

methods.name: JoinGroup
methods.description: Joins a multicast group.

methods.name: LeaveGroup
methods.description: Leaves a multicast group.

methods.name: SetMulticastInterface
methods.description: Sets the multicast interface.

methods.name: SetMulticastTimeToLive
methods.description: Sets the TTL for multicast packets.

methods.name: SetMulticastLoopbackMode
methods.description: Enables or disables multicast loopback mode.

methods.name: SetDiffServCodePoint
methods.description: Sets the Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP).

methods.name: DetachFromThread
methods.description: Detaches socket operations from the current thread.

methods.name: UseNonBlockingIO
methods.description: Configures the socket to use non-blocking I/O on Windows.
